entities.summary: Henry Sosa Esther is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for the Marineros de Carabobo of the Venezuelan Major League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Houston Astros, in the KBO League (KBO) for the Kia Tigers, Nexen Heroes, LG Twins, and SK Wyverns, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Fubon Guardians and Rakuten Monkeys.
